confidence_notes: The FX rate comes from RBA search results: 0.6720 USD per AUD for 18 Nov 2026. I did not open the RBA page itself. Food and drink anchors rest on five web searches, which returned mainly crowdsourced cost-of-living aggregates (MyLifeElsewhere, Expatistan, travel-cost pages). They disagree with each other and some are dated. Rough figures found: inexpensive meal about A$23-26, pint about A$8.6-9.1, cappuccino about A$4.2-5.6, mid-range 3-course meal for two about US$54 (older data), city-centre club cocktail about A$16 from 7 price points. I found no reliable Wollongong figure for wine by the glass. I set wine at roughly 1.4x beer and cocktail at roughly 1.9x beer, informed by happy-hour and venue listings of A$10-13 and typical Australian restaurant pricing. I nudged the mid-range meal up from the stale aggregate to reflect current menu inflation. The accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge of regional NSW coastal pricing. I did not search for accommodation or inspect any listings. The dorm and private hostel figures are the least certain, because Wollongong has very few registered hostels and prices vary by season and weekend demand.
comparable_city_reasoning: Wollongong is a regional coastal NSW city about 80 km south of Sydney. Its prices sit modestly below Sydney for food, drink and lodging and close to Newcastle. Crowdsourced aggregates put restaurant prices near the Australian average.
